mission: Capacity75 session 13 step 3 (owner decision 2026-10-14): quarantined/blocked refresh work reported as its own category with count and oldest age always visible, excluded from overdue and freshness deadline compliance; real overdue work still fails (state tooling only)

impacts.reason: State generator and check_raw_health only. A read-only query lists blocked items of the same ELIGIBLE population as DUE_SQL in the same read-only transaction; they are removed from due/overdue/never_checked/over_24h/deadline_misses and from run-summary misses only when blocked since before the run started and already overdue then (a real miss is never hidden). Quarantine count, overdue/never-checked counts and oldest blocked-since/age are always shown per source, in raw_due_work and in freshness; the freshness-deadline-deficit blocker follows actionable work; a quarantined-refresh-work blocker carries count and oldest time. Fails closed on older evidence or an inconsistent list. No threshold, target, budget or guard change; no database, Railway or Vercel write. The shared aggregate and its SQL (collector runtime inputs) are unchanged: scripts/collector_runtime_inputs.py reports 0 changed runtime inputs for both collectors, so no collector release.

Quarantined items do not count as overdue; real overdue work still fails (DEGRADED, due_work_deficit, not_met, deficit blocker); count and oldest age shown, also when zero; runs keep items blocked after they started or not yet overdue; inconsistent or absent lists exclude nothing; inputs not mutated; sanitize keeps only item fields.
Records the reporting rule and its fail-closed conditions.
